item.title: Version 26.1.1.4
item.description:
• New: DNS Refresh now shows Wi-Fi strength, link speed, and DNS server details.
  • Improved: DNS Refresh loads network diagnostics in the background for faster display.
  • Improved: Menu bar Open DiskCleaner now focuses the existing app window instead of opening a duplicate.
  • Fix: Reduced cleaning UI stalls by pausing Trash monitoring during cleanup.
  • Fix: Skips unreadable Trash roots to avoid repeated permission errors.
